speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the results; with normal liver function and a clear ultrasound, I need to know if you have any history of unexplained bruising or easy bleeding, and whether you have a specific rash or skin lesions. Additionally, have you traveled to areas where tuberculosis is common, or do you have any recent contact with individuals who have been diagnosed with TB?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you experienced any unintentional weight loss or loss of appetite? REQUEST TEST: LDH (Lactate Dehydrogenase) and Haptoglobin. Also, have you noticed any physical swelling or fluid retention in your legs or abdomen?
